card.name: Antiviral drug lists in interaction text
card.fires_on: Small words, punctuation or word starts inside lists of HIV and hepatitis C antiviral drugs (atazanavir, darunavir, ritonavir, cobicistat) in drug interaction passages. It sits just before the next drug name is spelled out.

modes.label: Between listed antivirals
modes.description: A linking word or comma between protease inhibitor names in an interaction list.
modes.example: Use with HIV-1 protease inhibitors other than atazanavir<< or>> darunavir administered once daily is

modes.label: Start of next antiviral name
modes.description: The first letter or piece of the next antiviral drug name after a comma or slash.

modes.label: Phrases around antivirals
modes.description: Words in phrases about protease inhibitors or loss of effect of antiviral combinations.
modes.example: which may lead to loss<< of>> therapeutic effect of GENVOYA and development

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated to the setting.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and name beginnings in lists of HIV and hepatitis C drugs.
